publications.name: The Long War - Codex Sisters of Battle

rules.name: Healing Tears
rules.description: Once per game, you may return 1 Slain Geminae Superia model to this unit with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Daemon
rules.description: A unit with this rule gains the Daemon Keyword. The Daemon unit has a 5+ Invulnerable save and the Fear (1) special rule. Daemon units have +1” to their Movement (M) characteristic. (This is included in unit data sheets that have the Daemon special rule by default)

rules.name: Miraculous Intervention
rules.description: The first time this unit would be slain and removed from play, it is not. The model instead removed from the battlefield and placed in ongoing reserves with D3 wounds remaining. If Saint Celestine would be placed in ongoing reserves as part of this special rule, any remaining Geminae Superia models in this unit are removed and placed in reserve with Celestine.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: This model increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The equipped model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: The Armour of Saint Katherine
rules.description: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour save and 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Cleanse with Fire
rules.description: All Ebon Chalice units in your army gain the +1 to their Strength characteristic on all ‘Flamer’ weapons they are equipped with. For the purposes of this special rule a ‘Flamer’ weapon is any weapon listed Flamer category of the weapon section.

rules.name: First of the Brides
rules.description:
Ebon Chalice armies may not include Cult Ministorum units and may not use
the Zealous Congregation Rite of War.

rules.name: Deeds, Not Words
rules.description: If your army is Argent Shroud, you do not generate any Faith Points from units with the Faith special rule in your army during the first battle round unless obtained via Relic Wargear.

rules.name: Devout Belief
rules.description: Increase all Argent Shroud units’ Invulnerable saves by 1 from Shield of Faith special rule to a max of 4+. In addition, Argent Shroud units gain the Deny the Witch special rule.

rules.name: Quick to Anger
rules.description: Bloody Rose units gain the Frenzy special rules.

rules.name: Impatient Fighters
rules.description: Bloody Rose units may not set to Overwatch

rules.description: All Our Martyred Lady Sisters of Battle, Dominions and Retributors units in your army gain the Martyrdom special rule.

rules.name: Unto Death
rules.description: Our Martyred Lady units may not perform Retreat moves in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Meditative State
rules.description: Sacred Rose units have -2” to all Charge rolls.

rules.name: Serene Grace

rules.name: Sword Bearer
rules.description: In the Combat Phase, at Initiative 4, this unit may make 3 additional Attacks with The Martyr’s Sword. You may not make more than 3 attacks per Combat Phase with the Martyr’s Sword.

rules.name: Praesidium Protectiva
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save. In addition, when this model is immune to Instant Death unless the Strength of the Attack is 11 or higher, or has the Blast (x) special rule.

rules.name: Simulacrum of Ebon Chalice
rules.description: Once per game, this unit may use the Blinding Radiance Act of Faith without spending a Faith Point.

rules.name: Simulacrum of Argent Shroud
rules.description: Once per game, this unit may use Faith Inviolate Act of Faith without spending a Faith Point.

rules.name: Petals of The Bloody Rose
rules.description: Rose: A model with this wargear always hits on a 4+ in the Combat Phase unless the units Weapon Skill (WS) is greater than the targets Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Censor of the Sacred Rose
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit may always set to Overwatch, even if it made a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. If the unit or its attached unit made an attack in the Shooting Phase, any Overwatch is resolved with Gets Hot! Special rule on all Shooting weapons the units are equipped with.

rules.name: Icon of the Valorous Heart
rules.description: Any unmodified hit roll of a 6 in the Shooting or Combat Phase from a model equipped with this wargear automatically wounds. Make saves as normal.

rules.name: The Fiery Heart
rules.description: All Adeptus Sororitas units which can draw visibility to this unit may use this units Leadership (LD) characteristic for Pinning and Panic Tests.

rules.name: Protector of the Faith
rules.description: If this unit is Warlord, it may re-roll failed Invulnerable Save rolls. In addition, this unit and any attached unit gain the Last Stand special rule.

rules.name: The Banner of Sanctity
rules.description: All friendly Imperium units within 24” of this model gain +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Icon of Chiros
rules.description: All friendly Imperium units within 12” and visibility of this unit add 1 to the number of wounds they inflicted in a combat for the purposes of determining who won combat.

rules.name: Booming Words
rules.description: Once per game, this unit can perform the Word of the Emperor Act of Faith even though it does not have the Act of Faith special rule. This Act of Faith does not cost a Faith Point.

rules.name: Leader of the Faithful
rules.description: If Arch Confessor Kyrinov is your warlord, you may include 1 unit of Zealous Congregation without taking up a Force Organization Slot and even if you are not running the Zealous Congregation Rite of War. If your Army is using the Zealous Congregation Rite of War, instead, at the start of each of your Movement Phases, you can select a single Zealous Congregation unit in your army within 12” of this unit. The selected unit regains D6 slain models.

rules.description: All Our Martyred Lady Sisters of Battle, Dominions and Retributors units in your army gain the Martyrdom special rule.

rules.name: Unto Death
rules.description: Our Martyred Lady units may not perform Retreat moves in the Movement Phase.

rules.name: Pulpit of Saint Holline's Basilica (Heavy Flamer)
rules.description: A model with this wargear has +1 to its Wounds (W) and Toughness (T) Characteristics. A model with this wargear has a Heavy Flamer. A model with this wargear gains the Relentless, Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Fade & Fire special rules. (This is included in the above profile).

rules.name: Righteous Hate
rules.description: If this unit is Warlord, it and all Infantry units in your army gain the Rage special rule.

rules.name: Blood of Martyr’s
rules.description: All Our Martyred Lady Sisters of Battle, Dominions and Retributors units in your army gain the Martyrdom special rule.

rules.name: Throne of Blame
rules.description: The unit is equipped with the Throne of Blame. The unit becomes a Walker type unit and gains all of the associated benefits. However, this unit cannot join Walker type units and may only attach to Infantry type units. The equipped unit gains +2 Toughness (T) & +1 Wounds (W) characteristics.

rules.description: Arco Flagellant models in this unit gain the benefit of the Frenzy, Rage and Feel no Pain (5+) special rules. However, Arco Flagellant models in this unit never benefit from the effects of Prayers.

rules.name: Storm Shield
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. A model equipped with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule

rules.name: Recount the Deeds
rules.description: Once per game, at the start of your Movement Phase, you perform a Leadership test. If the Leadership test is passed, you gain 1 Faith Point to your faith pool. If the test is failed, nothing happens.

rules.name: Auto-Tapestry of the Emperor’s Judgement
rules.description: All friendly units within 12” of this unit may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In additional, all friendly units within 12” count as scoring 1 additional Wound for the purposes of determining who won combat.

sharedRules.name: Martyrdom
sharedRules.description: When all models in a unit with this special rule are slain and removed from play, you gain 1 Faith Point.

sharedRules.name: Faith (x)
sharedRules.description: At the start of the first battle round before the first turn begins, a unit with this special rule contributes a number of Faith Points equal to the value of (x) to your starting Faith Point Pool.

sharedRules.name: Acts of Faith
sharedRules.description: At the start of the First battle round after deployment but before the first turn begins, your army will generate Faith Points (FP). To determine your initial pool of Faith Points (FP), generate a number of Faith Points equal to the value of (x) from all units with the Faith (X) special rule or any wargear, Warlord Traits or other abilities. All Faith Points from multiple units are cumulative.

sharedRules.name: Decree Passive
sharedRules.description: You may only include 1 unit with the Cult Ministorum keyword for every 3 Adeptus Sororitas units in your army. Units with this special rule may not be your warlord unless there are no Adeptus Sororitas units in your army.

sharedRules.name: Digital Weapons
sharedRules.description: A model with Digital weapons gains +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.

sharedRules.name: Chirurgeon's Tools
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Rod of Office
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear and any attached unit re-roll Leadership tests.

sharedRules.name: Simulacrum
sharedRules.description: Once per game, a unit equipped with this Wargear may perform a single Act of Faith (see Act of Faith section) for free without spending a Faith Point.

sharedRules.name: Incenser Cherubim
sharedRules.description: This model counts as a token for the purposes of being on the battlefield. You can spend the Incenser cherubim once per game and remove the token at any point in either player turn. The unit immediately performs the Emperor’s Grace Faith Power (see Acts of Faith section).

sharedRules.name: Litany of Deeds
sharedRules.description: Friendly Sisters of Battle units within 12” of the Banner can re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, add 1 to the number of wounds caused for determining the winner of a combat for any combat this model is involved with.

sharedRules.name: Sacred Banner
sharedRules.description: A unit with a model that is equipped with wargear automatically Rallies in the Movement Phase.

sharedRules.name: Simulacrum Nullifactus
sharedRules.description: Once per game, a unit equipped with this Wargear ignores a Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon which may target them.

sharedRules.name: Virge of Admonition
sharedRules.description: A unit that includes a model with this Wargear gains the Fear (1) special rule. In addition, enemy units gain -1 to Psychic Tests within 18” of the equipped unit.

sharedRules.name: Assassin Suit
sharedRules.description: A skintight and flexible suit used by assassins that allows unparalleled movement. It confers a 6+ Armour save and a 5+ Invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Mortifactor Engine
sharedRules.description: The armourer sarcophagus of this engine of penance provides protection to the pilot of this war machine. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

sharedRules.name: Loud Hailers
sharedRules.description: When a model with this wargear has the Fear (1) special rule.

rules.name: The Book of Saint Lucius
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains the Faith (1) special rule. If the unit already has the Faith (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: The Cloak of Saint Aspira
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic may re-roll failed Invulnerable saves.

rules.name: Skull of Petronella the Pious
rules.description: A model with this Relic and any attached unit gains a 6+ Invulnerable save. If they already have an Invulnerable Save, improve the Invulnerable Save by +1  Max 3+).

rules.name: Mantle of Ophelia
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic is immune to Instant Death and treats all Instant Death Wounds as normal Wounds.

rules.name: Litanies of Faith
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic automatically passes the first Leadership Test per Shooting Phase when attempting to perform a Prayer with the Priest (x) special rule.

rules.name: Desvalle's Holy Circle
rules.description: Enemy units may not arrive from Deep Strike or Outflank within 12” of a model equipped with this Relic wargear. In addition, the equipped model gains a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Beacon of Faith
rules.description: A warlord with this trait gains the Acts of Faith & Faith (1) special rule (see Army rules). If the unit already has the Faith (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

rules.name: Impervious to Pain
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Feel no Pain (5+) and Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Inspiring Orator
rules.description: All friendly units within 24” of a model with this Warlord trait may use the Warlord Leadership (LD) characteristic instead of their own.

rules.name: Cleanse with Fire
rules.description: All Ebon Chalice units in your army gain the +1 to their Strength characteristic on all ‘Flamer’ weapons they are equipped with. For the purposes of this special rule a ‘Flamer’ weapon is any weapon listed Flamer category of the weapon section.

rules.name: First of the Brides
rules.description:
Ebon Chalice armies may not include Cult Ministorum units and may not use
the Zealous Congregation Rite of War.

rules.name: Deeds, Not Words
rules.description: If your army is Argent Shroud, you do not generate any Faith Points from units with the Faith special rule in your army during the first battle round unless obtained via Relic Wargear.

rules.name: Devout Belief
rules.description: Increase all Argent Shroud units’ Invulnerable saves by 1 from Shield of Faith special rule to a max of 4+. In addition, Argent Shroud units gain the Deny the Witch special rule.
